decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm’s existing energy-tariff and calculation capabilities, is still promoted on its own page in 2024, and the firm’s in-house R&D and sector knowledge make continued improvement and commercial use likely.

The product is close to the firm’s established offer and therefore well within its absorptive capacity, but its reduced visibility from a dedicated page to only a website mention suggests some consolidation risk.

Because it builds on the firm’s core market-data and regional process expertise and fits the platform-expansion strategy, management is likely to retain it, although the weaker 2024 presentation indicates a moderate chance of withdrawal.
